title: Validate an NUnit test project targeting .NET Framework 4.7.2 (net472) through the standard launcher, recognition and registration
outcome: Validate an NUnit test project targeting .NET Framework 4.7.2 (net472) through the standard launcher, recognition and registration
acceptance: A disposable NUnit test project targeting net472 under the main checkout's .tmp/ (or an existing representative one, named with its path) has a passing run and a deliberately failing run, each executed on a Windows host both as a plain agent test command (one-call form) and through `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs focused -- <command>`, and for each run the host's recognition (check kind and result as reported in the turn's host observation or the declared-command result) and the launcher's registration and terminal outcome are recorded on this item with run ids.

Each observed pass is reported as a pass and each observed failure as a failure, with the test count, from the run's result artifact (TRX or NUnit XML) rather than from console output; any misjudgment, missing recognition or launcher defect found is filed as its own item with the evidence, or fixed within this item with a behavioral regression.
The item records the exact commands, the .NET Framework targeting pack, SDK, test adapter and runner versions observed, and the host, so the check can be repeated.
